title: A long, half-specified request gets one question, not a made-up quote

turns.user: Hi, we need a few things done — first the design, then the content, and later maybe the ads.

model.text: Happy to help. To scope it properly: what has to be live first, and by when?

turns.user: Design first. Budget is flexible but I don't want surprises. Also can you handle the printing and the delivery to two cities, and do you give a discount if we bundle all of it?

model.text: Understood — design first. Printing and delivery to two cities are possible; the owner confirms the final scope in writing. On the bundle discount I have to check with the owner rather than guess a number. One thing I still need: roughly how many items are we printing?
